scope: Fixed28 /4 development scenes. HOIPrior generates all DNO candidates; HSI supplies the same teacher. Metric-directed physical targets replace source-only grasp/slip preservation. Every raw arm and both references receive the identical relation20 plus terminal rule. Full469 is a separate later entry.

method.source: Replay the previous deterministic DDIM50 source from identical task-indexed seed42 noise and saved conditions. Check exact source prediction and noise against previous inputs.pt before any edit. DDPM500+ArmB remains a separate reference.
method.decoder: Full 232D HOI raw x0, 500-step training schedule with 50 rounded descending DDIM times and terminal alpha=1. Original final-window object SO3 projection. No Arm B posterior guidance inside DDIM; source and G/C/W all use the same unguided decoder. Historical DDPM500+ArmB is reported separately. All future latent blocks jointly optimized; generated history and rigid human/object frame conversions remain differentiable across windows.
method.conditioning: Recover original native window frames, text, object shape, per-window goals and progress once. These are common fixed conditions. Root and object paths are generated outputs; final supplied human/object goals enter the objective. First two global coarse history frames fixed; later histories come from the current rollout.
method.native: Native differentiable 30Hz output after final DNO step is preserved as raw. First3 native frames remain fixed. Separately run identical relation20 and terminal postprocessing for DDPM_reference/source/G/C/W. Save all intermediate/final states and rejected terminal candidates; native evaluator unchanged.
method.teacher: At each optimization iteration and window, add paired noise to the current HOI clean motion; freeze its two history frames. Query full R2 raw x0 using current-motion scene observations, native human goals and training-compatible empty object/contact channels. The wrong arm rotates all scene queries by 90 degrees about task start; true geometry and all non-scene conditions remain shared. Use detached HSI x0 as a refreshed local FK24 target, MSE/(5cm)^2 on future joints. HSI has no optimized latent and never supplies the output motion. This is an alternating local teacher surrogate, not a calibrated global density. Same per-step query RNG in C/W; log query coverage and paired source responses.
method.physical: Unit weights: root-local body5cm and velocity20cm/s preservation; source-stance height1cm; absolute stance foot speed5cm/s (zero target, source adjacent support masks); active grasp distance above3cm scaled1cm; object-frame grasp velocity10cm/s; source-relative route acceleration0.5m/s2; goals5cm; native HS/OS normalized as previous protocol; added native human-object depth sum scaled1m; added squared per-frame deepest scene distance shortfall below2mm scaled1cm withweight0.1 for both meshes; previous domain term. All surfaces and derivatives on GPU. The root-local/body/continuity constraints replace the removed noise-distance tether.

arm_definitions.G: HOI DNO + physical objectives, HSI weight0

method.readout_execution: Source, zero-edit replay and final readouts all enable latent gradients before the HOI forward pass and then detach. This keeps the frozen PyTorch Transformer on the same arithmetic path as optimization.
method.numerical_reference: Each physical source reference uses the same 24-frame plus two-frame-overlap SMPL-X block as the current candidate. Log its difference from canonical source output; source-preservation terms are exactly zero at the source up to arithmetic precision. FK24 teacher readout is checked against native SMPL-X first22+hands24/26 before optimization.
method.contact_interval: Source-native geometry defines all masks once. Preserve both hands source contacts below5cm. Main hand is the one with most source contact frames, tie chooses smaller mean object-surface distance. On the interval spanning any source contact or object translation speed>1cm/s, require main-hand3cm contact; exclude immutable first3 frames. Other hand retains its source-contact frames. Save masks, main hand, interval, distances and counts. Target is surface proximity and object-frame temporal coherence, allowing source penetration or grasp geometry to improve. No GT, task-id rules, per-object weights or best-of-N.

diagnostics.engineering: Same-noise source replay, scene-free HOI input contract, generated-history gradients into previous-window noise, root/body/object gradient reachability, shared C/W query RNG, native interpolation/FK derivatives, fixed initial history and resumable optimizer/RNG state. Full component and authority tests before formal launch.
diagnostics.gradient: Source correct/wrong and finalG/C/W retain independent weighted-term latent gradients. All new terms logged each step. Native human-object source value agrees with evaluator; min-distance/contact/stance masks archived. All final chains receive full native and original motion diagnostics.
diagnostics.sampling: Compare generated DDIM50 source with archived DDPM500+ArmB source on all native metrics. Their source sampling protocols differ. Direct editing attribution uses only the exact DDIM source and same decoder G/C/W.
diagnostics.geometry: Original motion/interaction/stance/route diagnostics plus new contact-mask coverage and repair counts. Raw and final chain reported separately; all stage timings GPU synchronized. Postprocess runtime and DNO runtime separate.

evaluation: All native metrics raw/relation/final for5 arms on the fixed28. Paired bootstrap10000seed42 tasks and scenes through existing implementation. Save per-object descriptive means and all violations. Compare to frozen historical results by reference, no altered evaluator or GT signals.

decision.limits: No weight search, best noise, additional seeds, evaluator changes or full469 in this experiment. Fixed28 and all469 have development exposure. Independent metric wins do not establish distribution realism.
